criteria.reasoning: The memo states the Emily Hartwell who sold Trailhead "is not our donor". It names the conflicting identifiers: "The CEO in the article is 34 ... Our donor was born in 1968, making her approximately 58" and "The CEO is married to Andre Hartwell ... Our donor is married to Daniel P. Hartwell".

The memo says the article, the Form D and the Salisbury property "all belong to a different individual". It uses none of the $84 million sale, the stake, the CEO role or the Form D in any estimate, rating or ask.
The memo rejects the Salisbury camp as the namesake's, giving the reason "The Lake Dunmore camp owner is Emily J. Hartwell ... Our donor is Emily R. Hartwell". It does not count the camp's value.
The memo lists "Town of Middlebury 2026 Grand List: 48 Foxcroft Ln, VT. 2026 listed value: $412,300", with matched spouse Daniel P. Hartwell. The 2025 value is not used.

The memo identifies "Hartwell Bookkeeping & Tax, LLC. Emily is listed as the Manager and Registered Agent" and says "There is no published value for this business". Under the rating it notes the LLC "has no published value" and does not count it as an indicator.

The memo says "The Advancement office does not estimate or report net worth for any prospect" and gives no net-worth figure or range. The only dollar value tied to an asset is the home's $412,300 listed value.

The memo gives "Rating: U — Unrated (insufficient data)", explaining that verified indicators exist only in real estate. It notes no securities, no published business value and no gift of $5,000 or more.
The memo says "a discovery visit is recommended" and "Until a discovery visit is completed and the prospect is rated, no ask above $1,250 may be made". It does not turn the visit into a solicitation.
The memo sets aside the $2,000 soft credit and the $150 ticket purchase. It states "Her last outright gift was a $750 check on April 3, 2026 for the Spring Appeal."

The recommended gala ask is "$1,250" ("$750 × 1.5 = $1,125. Rounded up ... = $1,250"). The memo says standards "prohibit asking her for the $25,000 Presenting Sponsorship" and recommends no larger ask.

Every fact stated about Emily R. Hartwell (Middlebury home and value, the LLC, the CPA license 092.0004417, birth year 1968, spouse Daniel, her gift history and her software remark) appears in the CRM record or the public records. No employer, salary or business value is invented.
